_comment: Single source of truth for acronym expansions. Consumed by tools/gen_acronym_domain.py (builds data/acronym.html) and tools/annotate_acronyms.py (adds inline expansions to data/*.html). Fields: a = acronym; m = list of meanings (e = expansion, c = subject area, n = optional note); annotate = expansion used for inline annotation when an acronym has several meanings (defaults to m[0].e); byDomain = per-domain-file override of that inline expansion, where null means do not annotate in that domain; noAnnotate = list in the dictionary but never annotate inline.
